page.title: Exit & Dispatch Performance
page.description: One config per station; at each trigger time, auto-compute before-11am hub exit rate and 24h dispatch rate.

list.noVendorTooltip: This config has no vendors selected — settlement produces no data. Click Edit to select the station's carriers.
list.viewDetailNoVendor: No vendors selected — click Edit to select carriers for this station first
list.viewDetailNoData: This station has no settlement data yet
list.settleNowTooltip: Settle this station now without waiting for the trigger time
list.settleNowConfirmDescPrefix: Both hub exit and dispatch rates will be settled and written to history immediately. Dispatch is a
list.settleNowConfirmDescSuffix: — the 24h window may not have truly closed; settling now may look stricter. The scheduled job at trigger time will re-run and overwrite with the authoritative value.
list.empty: No stations configured yet. Click "Add station" above to get started.

drawer.triggerTimeHint: Daily settlement runs at this time in the station's state timezone
drawer.vendorDescription: Only selected vendors are included in settlement
drawer.vendorFootnote: Missing vendors mean permanently missing history (no backfill). Verify against this station's actual carriers.
drawer.timingIntro: After saving, a daily job runs at the trigger time. The two metrics settle one day apart:
drawer.timingBefore11: Before 11am hub exit rate — Mon–Thu: yesterday's arrivals; Fri/Sat/Sun arrivals close at next Monday 11:00
drawer.timingSign24h: 24h dispatch rate — settles the day-before-yesterday arrival batch; must wait for the 24h window to close
drawer.timingFootnote: Early dispatch settlement is wrong because re-dispatch after route return corrupts the data, so it waits an extra day. Do not set trigger time before 11:00, or in-window waybills may be marked unmet.

detail.subtitle: Final values by arrival date, drill down by vendor / route code / driver
detail.settleNowConfirmDescPrefix: Hub exit rate settles and writes to history immediately; dispatch rate is computed on the spot only,
detail.settleNowConfirmDescSuffix: — the 24h window may not have truly closed; settling now may look stricter. Authoritative dispatch values are written by the scheduled job at trigger time.
detail.signPendingHint: Wait for the 24h window to close; the next day's scheduled job will fill it in
detail.exitMetSignUnmetHint: Handed to driver on time but not fully dispatched — driver side
detail.exitUnmetSignUnmet: Late hub exit and dispatch overdue
detail.exitUnmetSignUnmetHint: Late exit dragged down dispatch — warehouse cascade
detail.pendingDispatchDesc: The two metrics settle one day apart: hub exit is available the day after arrival; dispatch waits for the 24h window (one more day). The latest day in the range currently has hub exit only.

ranking.title: Supplier composite ranking
ranking.needTwo: Composite ranking needs at least 2 suppliers to be meaningful
ranking.weightHint: Effective weights: {{weights}}. Metrics with insufficient sample (hub-exit/dispatch denominator < 30, priority denominator < 10) are excluded and their weight is redistributed to the rest.
ranking.breakdownTitle: Metric breakdown (weights renormalized to enabled metrics)

attribution.title: Achievement attribution
attribution.subtitle: Splits every missed waybill into two causes: left the hub late (sorting/hub-exit side) and left on time but was not delivered (courier and workload side). Each points to a different action.
attribution.hintExitLate: Left the hub after 11:00 and still missed next day — chained failure, start with hub exit
attribution.hintDispatchSlow: Handed to the courier on time yet still missed — check courier, route and daily workload
attribution.hintMet: Signed or reported as a problem waybill before 23:59 the next day
attribution.liftTooltip: Difference between the two groups' next-day rates. A large gap means on-time hub exit matters a lot for this metric; near zero means the bottleneck is on the delivery side. This is observational correlation, not causation — on-time waybills also tend to land with the better couriers.
attribution.settling: Dispatch is not settled yet; attribution waits for tomorrow's settlement job
attribution.needsResettle: This range contains data from before the cross-tab counters shipped; re-settle those arrival dates to get attribution
attribution.noData: No assessable waybills in this range

pareto.title: Where the misses concentrate
pareto.subtitle: Sorted by missed waybill count — the order is the fix priority. Not by rate: 1 of 3 looks worse at 66%, but 50 of 1000 is what to fix first.
pareto.top20Tooltip: Near 20% means misses are spread evenly — replacing people will not help, change the process. Well above 20% means a handful are responsible and targeted action pays off most.
pareto.truncated: Chart shows the top {{shown}}; concentration uses all of them
pareto.settling: Dispatch is not settled yet; the ranking waits for tomorrow's settlement job
pareto.allMet: No missed waybills in this range

breakdown.whitelistPartialTooltip: In this range, {{whitelistTotal}} / {{total}} waybill(s) on this route are whitelisted (whitelist config changed mid-range). The page is in "All data" mode, so they count toward every metric above.
breakdown.whitelistFullTooltip: This route is on the vendor's route whitelist and is normally not scored. The page is in "All data" mode, so its volume and achievement count toward every metric above; switch to "Exclude whitelist" and this route disappears.
breakdown.driverAllMet: All waybills met for this driver in the range
breakdown.empty: No settled data for this range
breakdown.unpricedTooltip: {{count}} signed parcel(s) have no price for their postcode + suburb in Region Package Prices, so their amount is not included.
breakdown.profitPartialTooltip: Some arrival dates in this range are not settled yet, so no amount exists for them. This figure covers only the settled days, not the whole range.

profitStability.title: Profit Stability
profitStability.subtitle: Earnings, attendance, and day-to-day volatility across three dimensions — supplier, route code, and driver — sorted high to low; the driver dimension merges by person (across suppliers) to help decide who's a good full-time candidate.
profitStability.chartTruncated: Chart shows the top {{shown}} by profit only; the table below lists everyone
profitStability.crossSupplierTooltip: This entity is associated with more than one supplier in the selected range (drivers commonly from covering shifts or switching jobs); the figures below are merged
profitStability.cvTooltip: Standard deviation / mean of daily profit on worked days — lower means steadier daily earnings. Not shown when worked days < 2 or the mean is <= 0
profitStability.empty: No profit data for this range

settleResult.title: Settle now result
settleResult.nothingToProcess: No batches to process this run
settleResult.hubExitSettled: Hub exit settled and written to history
settleResult.hubExitSettledHint: Threshold is 11:00 on exit day; final once passed — early run matches scheduled run
settleResult.dispatchSettled: Dispatch settled and written to history
settleResult.dispatchSettledHint: For waybills exiting after 11am, the 24h window may not have truly closed; unmet counts may look high. The scheduled job at trigger time will re-run and overwrite.
settleResult.skippedDesc: New station first enabled, or the job failed when the batch was due. Backfill would read post-return re-dispatch state, so it is skipped.

toast.deleteConfirmContent: This station will no longer run daily settlement. Historical data is kept; re-add the config to view it again.
toast.jobAlreadyRunning: A settlement job is already running for this station — waiting for it to finish
toast.jobPollTimeout: Settlement still running — stopped waiting; refresh the page later for results
